description: An employer's live six-figure postings (highest published floors first, up to 10), pay summary and how fresh its job sources are. Give exactly one of: id (the `employer_id` from a search_jobs or get_job result) or slug (the /companies/<slug> part, e.g. 'amazon'). Company names are not ids.

id.description: Employer UUID: the `employer_id` field of a search_jobs result. Use this OR slug.

slug.description: Company slug from a /companies/<slug> URL, lowercase with hyphens, e.g. 'amazon'. Use this OR id.

name: get_employer
title: Get an employer
